tei:p.tei:seg: Thou art the Lord, thou alone. Thou hast made the heavens and the heaven of heavens with all their host, the earth and all the things upon it, the seas and all that is in them, and thou preservest them all; the host of the heavens worships thee.
Thou art the Lord God, who didst choose Abram, and didst bring him out of Ur of the Chaldeans, and gavest him the name of Abraham.

Thou didst find his heart faithful before thee, and didst make a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite, the Perizzite, the Jebusite, and the Girgashite—to give it to his descendants, and hast fulfilled thy words, for thou art righteous.
Thou didst see the distress of our fathers in Egypt and hear their cry by the Red Sea;

thou didst show signs and wonders on Pharaoh and all his servants and all the people of his
land, for thou knewest that they dealt viciously against them; and so hast thou made a name for thyself to this day.
The sea thou didst divide before them, so that they went through the middle of the sea on dry ground; and their pursuers thou didst cast into the depths, like a stone into the mighty waters.
